Demonstrate Azure OpenAI chat with the OpenAI SDK pointed at your Azure endpoint and deployment; use ComputerVisionClient for image analysis. Always use real Azure SDK commands. Report SDK versions, test results, endpoint connectivity, and example code verified against the service.
